title: Tea or coffee? This or that, by element
caption:
Tea or coffee? Choose carefully, your element is showing.

Air orders whatever everyone's having, plus cake. Fire ordered black coffee before you finished reading the menu. Water wants a big pot of tea and a long chat. Earth has had the same order for nine years.

Answer the five this-or-thats in the comments, then tag two friends to guess your element.
